sources.license: Per-dataset licenses are recorded by the pinned repository README and LICENSE files; selected sets include MIT, IJG/BSD, CC0, Freeware, BSD, Apache, CC-BY-SA, LGPL, and explicitly Various sources.
sources.licenseSource: https://github.com/imazen/codec-corpus/tree/8e10d4d765667c1c49d74413878fc4bfb46dcf8d README.md, LICENSE, and selected dataset README/LICENSE files

sources.license: LGPL-3.0-or-later for exif-py; user-contributed sample images retain the attribution and license records documented by the pinned repository.

derivedPolicy.description: Only used to fill a family minimum after eligible pinned real files are exhausted. Each derived JPEG or WebP is encoded by the pinned Playwright Chromium implementation from a hash-recorded decoded WPT PNG; it is not a synthetic pixel fixture.
derivedPolicy.encoderProvenance: https://playwright.dev/ and the exact package-lock resolution; browser binary version is recorded in the report

normalizationPolicy.text: No metadata-value normalization is used for acceptance. Package and ExifTool must both reparse the written output; payload ranges compare exact SHA-256 bytes; decoder dimensions compare exact positive integers; source order and unknown metadata signatures compare ordered multiset identities.
